environment.description: ECS Fargate task in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW). S3 access exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy. The endpoint policy specifies Condition block with StringEquals on s3:prefix requiring keys to start with 'thumbnails/' AND a Resource constraint limiting access to arn:aws:s3:::prod-thumbnails-7f3a2b/* only. Additionally, the task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/ThumbnailServiceBoundary) that denies s3:PutObject unless aws:RequestedRegion equals us-east-1 and s3:x-amz-content-sha256 is present. The VPC endpoint route table entry is the ONLY path to S3 from this subnet.

config.network: Isolated private subnet, no NAT/IGW, route table has only local + vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 prefix list for S3
